style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern woodworking classroom. An adult craftsperson is refining an ALREADY beautifully finished small wooden songbird sculpture: its shape and layered wing feathers are already elegant and smooth, and the person patiently buffs the final tiny feather edge with a small piece of fine sandpaper held naturally between fingers. The other hand securely supports the bird resting on a stable workbench. Beside it, two earlier equally good versions show progressive refinement, from a polished simple bird to a polished detailed bird. A child apprentice looks closely with admiration, learning to keep improving even after achieving excellent work. Show clearly fine finishing, not repairing a broken object and not working on a rough unfinished block. Natural human anatomy, five fingers per visible hand, sound wrist joints, hands in direct contact with bird and sandpaper, stable tools lying flat on bench. Three-quarter view with generous space, emphasis on the careful contact and refined bird feathers. Landscape exactly 3:2. No writing, labels, numerals, letters, brands, logos or watermarks. Graphite pencil linework, translucent muted watercolor, colored-pencil hatching, visible warm ivory paper texture.
alt: 木工師傅仔細打磨已經精巧光滑的木鳥羽毛邊緣，桌上較早的作品也很完整，孩子在旁專心學習。
